title: Advanced Paste not pasting while Keyboard Manager has enabled Left Ctrl remapping
author: EranYaacobi
summary: Advanced Paste's final synthetic paste chord appears to be getting remapped, and current source already exposes a narrow mismatch between the ad-hoc paste injection flag and the shared keyboard-hook bypass flag used elsewhere in PowerToys.

judgment.rationale: The issue body plus current source already isolate a concrete failing layer: the final synthetic Ctrl+V emitted by Advanced Paste is not reliably bypassing remappers, which is why a Left Ctrl remap can turn the intended paste into Win+V behavior or literal 2v.
evidence: The issue says Advanced Paste works normally until Keyboard Manager remaps Left Ctrl; with Left Ctrl -> Win, Advanced Paste closes without pasting, and with Left Ctrl -> 2 the target app receives 2v.
src/modules/AdvancedPaste/AdvancedPaste/Helpers/ClipboardHelper.cs injects the final paste chord as a generic Control+V sequence and tags it with a private 0x5555 extra-info value.
src/modules/interface/powertoy_module_interface.h defines the shared centralized keyboard-hook bypass flag as 0x110, and src/runner/centralized_kb_hook.cpp only bypasses exactly that value.

src/modules/AdvancedPaste/AdvancedPasteModuleInterface/dllmain.cpp already uses the shared centralized keyboard-hook bypass flag for other injected Advanced Paste input sequences, which makes ClipboardHelper's private flag choice stand out as the most likely inconsistency.
judgment.recommended_action: Approve a focused Advanced Paste design that routes the final paste injection through the same remap-safe keyboard-bypass path used elsewhere in PowerToys and adds Keyboard Manager remap regression coverage.

fix_assessment.rationale: No linked fix attempt is visible, and current source exposes a narrow, code-level mismatch in how Advanced Paste injects its final paste chord.

issue_context.summary: Advanced Paste stops pasting as soon as a Left Ctrl single-key remap is enabled, which means the final injected paste keystroke is still being interpreted through a remap-sensitive path.
known_information: The issue includes a clean five-step repro and a bug-report ZIP.
The failure happens even when Advanced Paste is opened by Win+V rather than by the remapped Ctrl key itself.

Changing the Left Ctrl remap target from Win to 2 changes the observed failure from nothing pasted to literal 2v being typed, which is a strong clue that the final synthetic paste chord is being transformed.
No assignee or linked fix is visible.
inferences: The bug is most likely in Advanced Paste's own synthetic paste path, not in clipboard selection or Advanced Paste UI closing logic by itself.
The symptom strongly suggests that Advanced Paste's injected Control key is not traveling through the same remap-safe bypass path as the rest of the module's hotkey plumbing.
issue_context.analysis: This is ready for a focused design and start decision. The issue-specific repro and the current-source flag mismatch together provide a narrow, testable fix path.
initial_investigation: src/modules/AdvancedPaste/AdvancedPaste/Helpers/ClipboardHelper.cs releases modifiers and then injects the final Control+V sequence with a literal 0x5555 dwExtraInfo tag.
src/modules/interface/powertoy_module_interface.h defines CENTRALIZED_KEYBOARD_HOOK_DONT_TRIGGER_FLAG as 0x110, and src/runner/centralized_kb_hook.cpp bypasses only that value.

src/modules/AdvancedPaste/AdvancedPasteModuleInterface/dllmain.cpp already uses the shared bypass flag for other Advanced Paste-generated input, which narrows the inconsistency to the final paste helper path.

actions.label: Approve remap-safe Advanced Paste design
actions.note: High-confidence fix path: align ClipboardHelper injection with the shared centralized keyboard-hook bypass contract and add remap regression coverage.

proposed_fixes.title: Make Advanced Paste's synthetic paste chord bypass remappers consistently
proposed_fixes.root_cause: ClipboardHelper sends the final synthetic Control+V with a private extra-info tag instead of the shared centralized keyboard-hook bypass flag already used by the module interface, allowing the paste chord to be reinterpreted by remap-related input handling on affected configurations.
plan: Replace the ad-hoc injected-key tag in ClipboardHelper with the shared centralized keyboard-hook bypass constant or route the final paste through the same remap-safe injection helper used elsewhere in Advanced Paste.
Validate that modifier-release behavior still prevents leftover Win, Shift, or Alt state from leaking into the target app while the final paste chord remains immune to remaps.

Add regression coverage for Left Ctrl remapped to Win and Left Ctrl remapped to a printable key so Advanced Paste still pastes the selected item instead of closing silently or typing transformed characters.
verification: With Left Ctrl remapped to Win, opening Advanced Paste and selecting a clipboard item should paste into the target app instead of simply closing.
With Left Ctrl remapped to 2, selecting a clipboard item should paste the clipboard content rather than typing 2v into the target app.
Advanced Paste should still work normally with no Keyboard Manager remaps enabled.

confidence.rationale: The issue provides a very specific remap-sensitive symptom, and current source shows an obvious inconsistency in the exact input injection path that can explain that symptom directly.
